name: attribution
title: Attribution and funding provenance profile
description: Optional CMS profile for linking an economic action to activity and evidence. Outside the scientific core. Status is allocation state, not ecological impact.
rules: Campaign association alone MUST NOT be exported as spend on a survey. Only explicit allocations belong in attributionRecords.
evidenceObservationIDs MUST reference observations that exist in this package.
Label activity counts as activity or evidence counts.
Use the name attributionRecords in exports and UI.
